Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('src-vul/xaac_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for name in ['mps_LD_sin_32k.wav.aac','noise_2ch_32khz_aot42_19_lufs_drc_mp4.aac','sine_2ch_48khz_aot5_drcoff_mp4.aac']:
    path='/tmp/'+name
    open(path,'wb').write(z.read(name))
    print('RUN',name)
    p=subprocess.run(['timeout','8','./work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer',path,'-runs=1'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('code',p.returncode)
    print(p.stdout[-500:])
    print(p.stderr[-500:])
PY` executed with exit code 0.
